01: Welcome to the ELTS Project Research Study. Thank you for being a participant. Before the study begins, we'll guide you through equipment setup and practice.
01-01: We'll explain each step as you go. If you have a question or need an instruction repeated, please ask the operator.
01-02: When you're ready, let the operator know. We'll begin with equipment setup.
02: The operator will now fit you with the tracking equipment, eye tracker, and heart-rate monitor.
02-01: Please let the operator know if anything feels uncomfortable or needs adjusting.
02-02: The operator will check the equipment before we continue. Once setup is complete, we'll move on to calibration.
03: First, we'll calibrate the head tracker. Please stand up straight and look straight ahead at the dot on the screen. Keep this position while the operator calibrates the tracker.
03-00-01: Stay in the same place. Turn your head to look at the dot on the left. Keep your head upright, and hold still.
03-00-02: Now turn your head to look at the dot on the right. Keep your body in the same place, and hold still.
03-00-03: Face forward again, then gently look up at the top dot. Keep your body in place, and hold still.
03-00-04: Face straight ahead. Step to your left until you are in front of the dot. Keep your head upright and facing forward, then hold still.
03-00-05: Now step to your right until you are in front of the dot on the right. Keep facing straight ahead, then hold still.
03-00-06: Return to your starting position in the center. Look straight ahead at the center dot, and hold still while the operator checks the calibration.
03-01: For this study, you'll use a replica that cannot fire. The operator will show you how to hold it with the stock against your shoulder. Please try this position, and let the operator know if it feels uncomfortable.
03-02: Now we'll calibrate the gun tracker. Hold the replica with the stock against your shoulder, as the operator showed you. Look down the sights and aim at the dot on the screen. Keep this position while the operator calibrates the tracker.
03-03: Calibration is complete. Next, we'll show you the study interface.
04: Let's look at the screen you'll use during the study. These are the practice targets.
04-01: Hold the replica as the operator showed you. Look down the sights and aim at the practice target.
04-02: Pull the trigger to fire the gun. Try firing once.
04-03: Well done. You've fired a shot. Next, try reloading.
04-04: Use the reload action the operator showed you to refill your ammunition.
04-05: Good job. Your ammunition is full again.
05: Now you'll have time to practice using the interface. This is practice, and your shots will not count toward the study results. Let the operator know when you're ready to begin.
05-01: Use this time to practice aiming, firing, and reloading. If you need help or another demonstration, please ask the operator.
05-02: Practice is complete. Let the operator know if you'd like another explanation before we continue.
06: The ELTS apparatus is directly below the middle of the screen. Its lights will be active during some of the study conditions. The operator will now demonstrate the lights briefly.
07: The demonstration is complete. Please let the operator know if you have any questions before we continue.
08: The study has four scenarios. You'll complete them in a randomized order.
08-01: Each scenario has a time limit. The operator will prepare each one before you begin.
08-02: You'll have a break between scenarios and another break after the final scenario.
09: With that, the tutorial is complete. Let the operator know when you're ready for the first scenario.
09-01: When you're ready, pull the trigger to begin this scenario.
10: This scenario has ended. Your break will begin shortly.
10-02: The next scenario will start shortly.
11: The scheduled scenarios have ended. Your final break will begin shortly.
11-01: Your final break begins now. After your break, you'll complete the post-study form.
11-02: Please complete the post-study form provided by the operator. If you have any questions, please ask.
11-03: Thank you for being a participant in the ELTS Project Research Study.
